tracker._note: Japan eSIM price tracker (/guides/esim/japan-esim-price-tracker, public/data/japan-esim-prices.csv). lib/esim-tracker-core.js reads this block. autoFacts: non-price facts for the five providers in `providers` above, whose prices scripts/fetch-esim-prices.mjs re-reads daily (their checked date is fetchedAt). providers: read by hand on each provider's own Japan page, re-checked on the 1st of every month; prices in the currency the site shows, converted to USD with fx. unpriced: providers checked but with no per-plan price we could read. A fact a provider does not publish is null — never guessed.
tracker.updatePolicy: Manual rows are re-checked on the 1st of every month; the five automated rows are re-read daily.

fx.source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates, via the Frankfurter API

unpriced.name: Klook Japan eSIM
unpriced.reason: Klook answers automated reads with HTTP 403, and its listing shows only a from-price (US$1.05, read in a browser on 6 Nov 2026) before days and data are chosen, so no per-plan price can be recorded.

unpriced.name: Saily
unpriced.reason: saily.com/esim-japan/ returned a bot challenge (HTTP 403) on 11 Nov 2026, so no price could be read from the official page.

unpriced.name: GigSky
unpriced.reason: The Japan page loads its plan list with JavaScript; no plan prices were present in the page HTML as of 11 Nov 2026.

unpriced.name: IIJ Japan Travel SIM (eSIM)
unpriced.reason: IIJ's product page lists the eSIM's 3–55 GB / 30-day tiers but gives the price as an open price set by the retailer, so there is no official price to record.
